result.summary: The image shows a residential street intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. While a sidewalk is present, its condition is fair and sightlines are partially obstructed by vegetation and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalk at the intersection increases risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflict.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: Absence of ramps makes the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Overgrown vegetation on the left corner and parked cars on the right may hide pedestrians from drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left corner and right side of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection and trim vegetation to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk and a modern curb ramp with tactile warnings at a residential corner. However, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks and visible traffic control devices, creating an environment where pedestrians must cross without designated protection. The building's proximity to the corner also creates a potential sightline obstruction for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: No painted markings to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to the crossing point.

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to manage vehicle speeds or right-of-way at the corner.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: The building is situated very close to the corner, potentially obscuring the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Install painted crosswalks to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Stop sign installation
interventions.description: Add a stop sign to control vehicle movement and provide safer crossing opportunities.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or signals. While sidewalks are present, the wide, unmarked roadway and visual obstructions from parked vehicles create a higher-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross the street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles, including a mail truck and cars along the curb, block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This residential intersection is largely devoid of pedestrian infrastructure, lacking marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and continuous sidewalks. Heavy vegetation at the corners creates significant sightline obstructions for both pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide intersection without designated markings or right-of-way protection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense, overgrown vegetation at the corners blocks visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the roadway lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown bushes at the intersection to restore clear sightlines for all road users.
